sourceNote: A copy of assets/models/pig/pig.glb with new upper arms (assets/models/pig/README.md). The mesh has no upper arm of its own, so tools/blender/pig_arms.py removes the bulge of the trunk wall above each elbow, fills the wall again, and builds a round tube up to a closed dome around the shoulder joint.
name: Pig

app.note: No reference image shows a pig, so the pig takes the size of its parametric body. The scale puts the standing skull top (0.9476 u) at 1.137 m, with the standing shoulder joints at 0.671951 m. The reach is the reach of the arm factor, from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The factor of the upper arm and the forearm. The arms of the mesh are short, so the factor 1.5 gives a reach of 0.385 m. The long snout puts the horn far in front of the body, so the hold of the pig turns the horn back toward the body (SPECIES_WIND_HOLDS.pig of src/pose/winds.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. Do not stretch the legs: change the chair.

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within radius (units) of the head of an upper arm take the normals of the skin with no crease angle (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, studioNormals() of src/models/studio-normals.ts), as on the rhino. Thus the arm root shows no hard seam and no dark wedge.

upperTwist.note: The twist bone of each upper arm keeps 0.4 of the roll of the upper arm from the chest (StudioBody.upperTwist), the share of the hippo and the rhino.

jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the tips of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The small curled tail is a ball on one bone at the back.

studio.note: The seated posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 15 degrees out, so that the horn has room at the right knee, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). The foot and the toes keep the turn of the source, so that the soles stand flat on the floor.

armFree.note: The tube of each upper arm and the forearm have no face that joins them to the trunk. A vertex of the free arm lies beyond the plane, within 0.075 u of the chain of the arm joints, and above y 0.3, so that the wall under the arm and the belly beside the paw follow the trunk.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the round haunch stays on the hips.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm (armFree) follows the arm bones. The plane lies inside the tube at the shoulder joint, so that the whole tube is in the free arm. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the ears follow the head.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh pig --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

border.note: In the box of the trunk, from y 0.4 to the chin, each dark fur face takes the color of the nearest light fur face, so that no black sliver shows under the raised right arm. The dark hooves lie on the free arms, below the box.

tone.note: Each plain face takes the hue and the chroma of the species color of its band (SPECIES_COLORS.pig) and keeps its lightness, as for the panda. A row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab. The dark hooves and the snout disc keep their colors.

colors.note: A dark face in the eye box is an eye. The config has no nose box: the snout disc has no dark faces, and the front-most vertex of the head near the middle plane is the middle of the snout disc.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The half width holds the haunch. The front edge lies behind the short thighs, and the back edge holds the back of the haunch.

raise.note: The shape of the right arm on the horn, with the mean turns of the play samples of the hold (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 81,213,216,438 --side R). Each face of the right armpit below the cosine 0.3 relaxes, with one ring of trunk corners (grow).
The shape of the left arm on the valves, with the mean turns of the play samples (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 1169,1888,1936 --side L).
The shape of the bent left wrist on the valves (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 1896,2638 --side L --bone hand). The rule turns 10 degrees past the mean of the play samples.

The shape of the right arm in the rest pose of the horn, with the mean turns of the rest samples (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 81,213,216,438,437 --side R --sets rest). Four rules is the limit of a body (RAISE_LIMIT), so the right paw of the rest has no shape.
